name: io.github.lanz/tenable-docs-mcp
title: Tenable Docs MCP
description: Cited answers from Tenable's product documentation, in every product, version, and language

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Keeps the documentation index between runs, so it isn't downloaded and built again each time

environmentVariables.name: TDM_SITES
environmentVariables.description: Only download these sites' docs, such as en,jp (default: all eight)

environmentVariables.name: TDM_INDEX_URL
environmentVariables.description: off turns automatic downloads and updates of the index off
